rule: Two coloured panels sit on a leftover frame colour; each panel holds near-rectangles of one shared shape colour with border defects. Every notch (non-corner border cell showing panel colour) becomes a bar with the cell just outside it, and every bump (shape cell just outside a non-corner border cell) becomes a bar with the border cell just inside it. Bars take the colour of the other panel.
scope: Two overlapping or split panels each contain near-rectangular shapes. Every non-corner notch or bump becomes a two-cell border-straddling bar in the other panel colour. Native shapes3..11 and grids14..30 by default; controlled dimensions8..30 with one side>=14. Explicit latent scenes retain valid broader defect/size cases.

authored_scope: Supported: random grids 14..30 per side by default (8..30 if explicitly requested, longer side >= 14; non-fixture sizes are synthetic extensions); free (overlapping, later panel on top) or split layouts with optional 1-2 cell frame gap; 1-3 shapes per panel; rectangles 3..11 in both orientations clamped to the panel box; 1-4 non-touching notch/bump defects per shape; at least one notch, one bump and two defect sides per scene; caller control of frame, shape colour, panel colours and layout; explicit latent reconstruction of the fixtures. Not supported: more than two panels, multiple shape colours, defects at corners, adjacent/touching defects, shapes touching a panel boundary, interior holes, caller control of shape counts or defect counts.
authored_constraints: frame, two panel colours and shape colour are four distinct integer colours (bools rejected)
each panel holds at least one shape and some frame cell remains visible
each shape keeps a panel-coloured ring (2 cells on bump sides) entirely within its panel's visible region
defect cells are pairwise non-adjacent (Chebyshev distance > 1) and on non-corner positions
the true rectangle is recoverable by the >half-max row/column rule
shapes plus bars of different shapes do not touch (halo check)
only the shape components are enclosed by a single colour; no frame/panel component has one neighbour colour
explicit-mode structures are type- and shape-checked before use
